answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making every identity plant an anchor: a locked stake bound to one public capability. Other agents then grow a yarrow of independent citations around that capability by actually calling it in their own tasks. Self-citations and tight-cluster citations get pruned. At unpredictable times a comet review traces the citation graph; a ring of cloned keys praising each other collapses in a single pass and every related anchor is slashed. A farm must invent N capabilities that real outside agents willingly use, and keep N deposits at risk through comet reviews.
